_note: Edit this file to change the Model Guide page (model-guide.html). Sizes come from `ollama list`. Descriptions are a first draft written from the model names and families, not tested on this Mac: please correct anything that does not match your experience. Run scripts/model-guide-sync.sh to add stubs for newly downloaded models.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.good_for: Quick questions, drafting, light homework help.
models.notes: Small and snappy. A good first choice when you just want an answer.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B
models.good_for: Clear, friendly explanations and everyday chat.
models.notes: Google's Gemma family. The base model behind Study Buddy.

models.name: Gemma 4 (32k memory)
models.notes: Looks like a custom version of Gemma 4 with a longer memory (32k context). Useful for the cookbook and other big files.

models.name: Qwen3 30B-A3B
models.notes: A mixture-of-experts model: only a small part works on each word, so it is quicker than its size suggests. (qwen3:30b is the same model under another name.)

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B (Apple MLX)
models.notes: A build made for Apple chips. May run faster on this Mac.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B (MLX)
models.good_for: Bigger questions where you want a second opinion.
models.notes: NVIDIA's Nemotron family, in an Apple-chip build. One of the heavier models here.

models.name: Qwen3 Coder 30B
models.notes: Built for programming. Fine for ordinary chat too, but others suit that better.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1 32B
models.notes: Thinks out loud at length before answering, so it is slow and wordy. Overkill for simple questions.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.good_for: Big, careful answers when speed does not matter.
models.notes: Uses most of the Mac's memory and can slow everything down for everyone. Use sparingly.

models.name: Apertus 1.5 8B
models.notes: A Swiss open model, developed in the open. This copy is the full-precision version, so it is larger than 8B models usually are.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo
models.notes: Not a chat model. It only matters once image generation is switched on.

models.name: Nomic Embed Text
models.good_for: Works behind the scenes to search your documents.
models.notes: Not for chatting. You will not need to pick it.

models.name: GLM 5.2 (cloud)
models.notes: Runs on someone else's computers, so anything you send leaves this Mac. Off for everyone until it has been vetted.
